flawless: Strength is not in the fist but in the forest. You fought only me.
The troop watched you fall and did not even stop eating.
solid: You struck true. The old ape feels it in his bones.
Every spell you cast fed my wisdom. Thank you, young one.
close: Hrrm. Old bones, close call. The troop will groom me for days.
Rarely does a stranger push the elder so far. Go with the trees.
